naming_findings: Two unrelated engine functions share the name GetCollisionObject, distinguished only by const; NG's name belongs to the const one, so the non-const one should get a distinct name, labelled GUESS.
The noinline attribute on this function has no caller left in the unit and compiles to nothing; it is a leftover that should be removed.
The noinline comment states the reason as a fact about the engine, but it is the Drafter's inference from one observed caller.
